'''''Double Helix''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The painting depicted the aforementioned double helix structure of a [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] strand, with two [[torton]]s or [[tortur]] at the top and bottom connected by the strand. The top creature was [[Color/Legends|colored]] red while the bottom creature was blue in color. Its look suggested it would be found hanging in the offices of a [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineering]] company.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Double Helix'' was a poster available to players of the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It could be obtained by looting a picture printer and various other items from enemies within the game. Once collected, you could combine the items and get a random painting. The other paintings you could receive were ''[[Droid in Contrast]]'' and ''[[Bio-Engineer Poster]]''. The player could use the painting as decoration for their home.
